chunks.title: Emirates NBD (Emirates NBD) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Emirates NBD is a Global Commercial Bank headquartered in United Arab Emirates. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: COP31 Business Forum Climate Finance & Investments Working Group member. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: $30B sustainable finance target by 2030 covering green loans, sustainability-linked finance & MENA-Türkiye climate transition corridors. Source verification: https://www.copbusiness.org/papers/COP31_WG_climate-finance-investments.pdf.

chunks.title: Emirates NBD Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Emirates NBD provides the following climate financing instruments: Green Loan, Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL), Green Bond / Green Sukuk, Trade & Transition Finance. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 5,000,000 to USD 300,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary, Mid-Cap Enterprise.

chunks.title: Emirates NBD Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Emirates NBD: Renewable Energy, Resilient Cities & Infrastructure, Water & Climate Adaptation, Industrial Decarbonization, Clean Transport. Target geographic focus includes: MENA, Türkiye, EMEA, Asia. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Emirates NBD Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Emirates NBD's application form: Emirates NBD Sustainable Finance Framework alignment; ICMA GBP / LMA GLP compliance & KPI reporting; Credit underwriting & Second-Party Opinion for labeled issuances. Explicit exclusion rules: Unabated coal projects. Official application portal: https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/sustainability.

chunks.title: Emirates NBD Form Template: Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake
chunks.text: Emirates NBD uses the 'Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake' workflow governed by LMA/APLMA Green Loan Principles (GLP), Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles (SLLP) & ICMA GBP. Typical review timeline is 3–8 weeks (Sustainable Finance Structuring -> Credit Committee -> Syndication/Close). Form sections required: 1. Borrower Overview, 2. Structuring, 3. Transition Credibility, 4. Risk & Underwriting, 5. Mandate Pitch.
